subject.title: [Feature]: Feature Request: Batch Tool Calls + Context Block Management + Plan Enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw pursue this umbrella as separate core/API design tracks, and which of batching, context-block lifecycle, and plan enforcement should be core-owned versus plugin-owned?
rationale: The request adds new tool schemas, config/default surface, session/context semantics, and runtime gating behavior that cannot be safely chosen by cleanup automation.

options.title: Split into design tracks
options.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella and require separate maintainer-reviewed proposals for native batching, context lifecycle, and plan enforcement before implementation.

options.title: Narrow to context lifecycle
options.body: Treat the context block portion as overlapping the existing manual context-clearing track and defer batching and plan enforcement until stronger evidence appears.

options.title: Route optional enforcement outside core
options.body: Limit core work to missing extension APIs and ask optional workflow enforcement or custom batching wrappers to live as plugins or ClawHub packages.

recommendation.title: Split into design tracks
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella and require separate maintainer-reviewed proposals for native batching, context lifecycle, and plan enforcement before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest combined history across structured planning, agent-tool parameter surfaces, and the prior keep-open review.
